concept: EBS: sharing a CMK-encrypted snapshot across accounts
tests: What's needed to share an EBS snapshot encrypted with a customer managed key with another account.
expected: Two steps: share the snapshot (modify permissions) with the target account + grant that account permissions on the CMK in the key policy (kms:Decrypt, kms:CreateGrant, DescribeKey, etc.). Triggers: "encrypted snapshot", "customer managed key", "another account".
why_not: An encrypted snapshot can't be made public; removing encryption isn't a sharing mechanism; snapshots aren't shared via an S3 bucket. A snapshot encrypted with the AWS managed key (aws/ebs) can't be shared at all.
